title: Audit logging
statement: The system shall record authentication attempts, authorization failures, index changes and administrative actions in an append-only audit log exportable to an external sink, with property values redacted.
rationale: Accountability evidence for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 without retaining PII.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each listed event type produces an audit record with timestamp, principal, action, target and outcome within 5 seconds.
Audit records contain no node or edge property values.
